summary_en: baudroie, inc. issued a correction to its MBO announcement dated August 19, 2026. The correction addresses specific details regarding the acquisition structure, including minimum tender conditions of 3,135,200 shares (9.55% of outstanding shares), the parallel share transfers from founder shareholders at 2,350 yen per share, and conditions related to warrant exercises by employees.
title_en: Notification Regarding Partial Corrections to "Notification Regarding Implementation of MBO and Recommendation of Tender Offer"
translation_en_brief:
This is a correction notice to baudroie, inc.'s MBO announcement issued on August 19, 2026. The acquirer is implementing a two-step acquisition to delist the company and obtain all outstanding shares.

The correction clarifies key conditions of the public tender offer. The minimum tender threshold is set at 3,135,200 shares, representing 9.55% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock). This floor is designed to ensure the acquirer obtains at least two-thirds of total voting rights needed to conduct a subsequent share consolidation under the Companies Act Article 180. There is no upper limit on the tender offer, as the acquirer intends to acquire all shares. Concurrently with the tender offer, three founder shareholders will sell their shares directly to the acquirer at 2,350 yen per share: Shiguhiro Tominaga (12,176,000 shares, 37.09%), Kazuya Fujii (4,539,000 shares, 13.83%), and the third founder (1,224,600 shares, 3.73%). These parallel transfers total 17,939,600 shares, or 54.65% of outstanding shares.

The correction also addresses the treatment of employee warrants. Employees holding transferable warrants granted by the founders are expected to exercise those warrants and tender the acquired shares in the public offer during the tender period. The founders have committed to facilitate and modify warrant exercise conditions where necessary to enable employee participation. Certain shares underlying unexercisable warrants may be excluded from the founders' share transfer obligations if warrant holders satisfy specified conditions.
